summary: Concept Ventures calls itself Europe's largest pre-seed fund and a generalist investor with no verticals. Its About page states cheques of up to $1,500,000 in first rounds, typically as lead or co-lead, a current fund of $88,000,000 and reserved follow-on capital. The homepage features early investments such as ElevenLabs. The site links a Notion page with more details and a team page; no application form or street address was found on the pages reviewed.

publicContactPeople.name: Reece Chowdhry
publicContactPeople.role: Team member (role not stated on the About page)

investmentEvidence.fact: Featured on the homepage as an early investment (childhood friends solving dubbing), now at an $11bn valuation. The initial round and date are not stated.
The About page describes the investment process using the Anam investment as a case study, including a $9m seed round with Redpoint. The date is not stated.
